#!name=车来了(小程序)净化

[MITM]
hostname = web.chelaile.net.cn, api.chelaile.net.cn, cdn.api.chelaile.net.cn, cdn.web.chelaile.net.cn, atrace.chelaile.net.cn

[Rewrite]
^https?:\/\/.*chelaile\.net\.cn\/goocity\/flowPos\/listByPos - reject
^https?:\/\/cdn\.web\.chelaile\.net\.cn\/info-flow\/index\.html - reject
^https?:\/\/.*chelaile\.net\.cn\/(api\/)?adpub - reject
^https?:\/\/124\.70\.194\.16\/(ip|adpub) - reject
^https?:\/\/124\.70\.194\.16\/goocity\/flowPos\/listByPos - reject
^https?:\/\/web\.chelaile\.net\.cn\/api\/operative_position\/infoflow - reject
^https?:\/\/atrace\.chelaile\.net\.cn\/(wx_preloadAd|adAnalysis) - reject

[Script]
http-response ^https?:\/\/.*chelaile\.net\.cn\/goocity\/city!, script-path=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ddgksf2013/Scripts/refs/heads/master/chelaile.js, requires-body=1, max-size=-1
